objective: Rebuild the Automation page UI around one coherent responsive React Flow experience while preserving existing automation behavior and contracts.

acceptance.criterion: Automation overview renders saved Flow summary nodes with kind, trigger, condition/action summary, enabled state, and chain edges.
next_flow_ids produce directed animated edges and a cycle candidate is not selectable.
Node palette exposes sensor, FSM, Cron, Webhook, condition, condition group, time-window, delay, alert, control, recipe, and chain capabilities.
Nested AND/OR condition groups render, edit, and round-trip without losing leaves, nesting, or operators.
mean/min/max conditions expose a window in minutes and preserve mode/windowSec through editor and compiler round-trip.
acceptance.verification: Vitest time-window editor and compiler tests

acceptance.criterion: Cron trigger UI stores a cron expression and displays the next scheduled run using the existing timezone context.
Webhook trigger UI supports flow/direct mode and bodyPath-to-targetField mappings.
Chain action selects a Flow, displays the chain preview, and blocks self/cyclic targets.
acceptance.verification: Vitest chain selector and flowCycle tests

acceptance.criterion: Test Panel accepts sample field values, runs the current IR through the existing validation/dry-run path, and renders trigger/result/trace/action output states.

Multi-device template UI lets the user select devices and shows override/inherited state; apply is permitted only through a discovered Automation bulk contract that preserves local overrides, otherwise the UI explicitly blocks unsupported apply without issuing a client-side mutation.
acceptance.verification: Vitest multi-device template tests plus the discovered Automation bulk API contract, or a blocked-apply test when that contract is absent

acceptance.criterion: Desktop matches the supplied 00-09 information hierarchy and mobile/tablet does not render the draggable desktop canvas.
acceptance.verification: Component tests for responsive branches plus manual visual inspection at 1440x900 and 390x844

acceptance.criterion: All frontend verification commands pass after final rebase and documentation is synchronized.
acceptance.verification: jules.yml frontend build/test/lint/fmt commands plus documentation diff inspection
